data.gender_notes: Rida is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rida is a name that symbolizes approval and satisfaction. It is often associated with positive emotions and a sense of contentment. In Islamic tradition, Rida is considered a blessed name. The name Rida carries the meaning “Pleasing, Acceptable, Joyful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rida usually hope their child will grow to embody pleasing, acceptable, joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rida has roots in the Arabic language, where it means "pleased" or "content" in English. In many Muslim cultures, giving a child this name is believed to signify a parent's approval and satisfaction with their child's arrival into the world. It is a name that speaks of joy and happiness. In addition, the name is reminiscent of the partnership and trust that exists between parents and their children.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic terms, Rida carries spiritual significance that is deeply rooted in the concept of submitting oneself to the will of God. The name is closely linked to the concept of Tawakkul, which means trusting and relying on Allah. A person named Rida is seen as constantly seeking approval and satisfaction from God, striving to live a life that is pleasing to Him. In this way, the name Rida serves as a reminder of the importance of remaining steadfast in one's faith and always seeking to draw closer to Allah. Ultimately, it is a name that conveys a sense of peace, contentment, and trust in the divine plan.
